title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): State Charge on a Moved Certificate, by the New Term's State
content:
**Clause.** A transfer state charge is added to the moved certificate fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44). A moved certificate is the state-change refiling a named insured orders after moving. The charge follows the state group of the new term's own state:

- the resident state of a new Named Non-Owner Policy term;
- the garaging state of a new Owner Auto Policy term.

| New term's own state | Transfer state charge |
|---|---|
| Florida or Virginia | 6.00 |
| Texas or Georgia | 3.00 |
| Arizona or Ohio | none |

**Basis Q&A.**

- *Is the old term's state read?* No. The new term's own state decides this charge.
- *A new Owner Auto Policy term garaged in Virginia:* 6.00.
